map.输入UV吸收峰 (nm)，逗号分隔: Enter UV absorption peaks (nm), comma separated

map.📚 深度解析：结构鉴定（IR/UV/NMR/MS）解析: 📚 In-depth analysis: structure identification (IR / UV / NMR / MS) interpretation
map.IR 1710 cm⁻¹→C=O、3300 cm⁻¹→O−H；UV λmax≈2: IR 1710 cm-1 corresponds to C=O and 3300 cm-1 to O-H; UV with lambda max around 270 nm indicates an aromatic ring conjugation; 1H NMR delta 2.3 corresponds to C=O-CH3.
map.分子离子峰 M=298（偶数）→ 含 0 或偶数个氮；常见丢失 15(CH₃)/: A molecular ion peak M = 298 (even) means it contains zero or an even number of nitrogens; common losses of 15 (CH3), 18 (H2O) and 28 (CO) indicate the corresponding groups.
map.不含氮或偶数氮的有机分子 M 为偶数；奇数氮则 M 为奇数。: Organic molecules with no nitrogen or an even number of nitrogens have an even M; an odd nitrogen count gives an odd M.
map.NMR 怎么定结构？: How is the structure determined by NMR?
map.化学位移+裂分+积分联用，δ2~3 多为羰基旁/苄基氢。: Chemical shift, splitting and integration are used together; delta 2 to 3 is mostly hydrogens next to a carbonyl or a benzylic hydrogen.
